notes: Grundl: huge haulers. THE LARGE RIG: the frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24) (the normal 2x2 body, 32 px, sits at the centre, its shadow and pathing stay there; the art overhangs it). Mounts and hands are the shared targets moved by (+8,+8), so they are identical relative to the pivot and every item fits (item top-left = mount - item.grip, as everywhere). A hunched back under a strapped cargo container, a dark brown hide, a blunt tusked jaw with small amber eyes, thick limbs, big fists, a slow stomp (5 fps). Head variants: tusked, cap (a flat hauler's cap, tinted). Outfit mask = harness straps, apron, wrist and shin wraps, cap. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. LARGE RIG: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every anchor here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot and hand - pivot are identical to the human rig.
